parts.name: Surface
parts.Basic_description: This is the main surface or body of the clock, made of aluminum, circular in shape, and serves as the base for the clock hands and hour markers.
parts.Functional_description: It supports the clock mechanism and provides the structure for mounting the hands and hour indicators.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary and does not move during operation.

parts.name: Hand (Hour Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the hour hand of the clock, made of steel, shorter and thicker than the other hands.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the hour by rotating slowly around the clock face.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 12 hours.

parts.name: Hand (Minute Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the minute hand of the clock, made of steel, longer and thinner than the hour hand.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the minutes by rotating around the clock face once every hour.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the central axis once every 60 minutes.

parts.name: Hand (Second Hand)
parts.Basic_description: This is the second hand of the clock, made of lightweight aluminum, thin and long for precise movement.
parts.Functional_description: It indicates the seconds by rotating around the clock face once every 60 seconds.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates continuously around the central axis once every minute.
